core.title: Friday flu vaccine delivery at Cornerstone
core.setting: Pharmacy manager at Cornerstone Community Pharmacy

events.text: Standing rule for Cornerstone Community Pharmacy: any supplier order totalling more than 800 needs sign-off from Priya Shah, our responsible pharmacist, before it is placed.
Standing rule: all refrigerated deliveries must be received by a pharmacist and logged in the fridge book within 30 minutes of arrival; never leave a cold-chain tote at the back door unattended.
Confirming Medwell Wholesale supplies Cornerstone Community Pharmacy from our Bristol depot; standard order line is 01454 555 210, cut-off for next-week delivery is Wednesday 17:00.
I am on the rota as duty pharmacist every Friday at Cornerstone through the autumn, so I can receive cold-chain deliveries on Fridays without any extra cover.
Autumn flu vaccine stock is confirmed: we can supply Cornerstone Community Pharmacy 200 units of the seasonal flu vaccine per weekly drop, at 6.40 per unit, while autumn allocations last.

I set up the autumn flu vaccine arrangement: 200 units per week from Medwell Wholesale, delivered each Friday so Priya can receive the cold chain, starting Friday 26 June. At 6.40 a unit the weekly order is 1280, so Priya pre-approved the recurring weekly order under the 800 threshold rule.
Your delivery window at Cornerstone is Fridays between 09:00 and 11:00; the driver calls the shop when he is ten minutes away.
I booked the Friday 09:00 to 11:00 delivery window with Medwell for the weekly flu vaccine drop and put it in the delivery diary as a recurring booking.
Greendale Care Home would like Cornerstone to run a flu jab morning for our 34 residents on site; our nurse suggests a Tuesday in early November.
I pencilled the Greendale Care Home flu jab morning for Tuesday 3 November at the care home, to be staffed by our locum pharmacist once we confirm one.
First flu vaccine drop went out this morning: 200 units on the Friday van to Cornerstone, arriving in your 09:00 to 11:00 window.
Fridge book checked: first flu delivery logged by Priya at 09:40, all temperatures in range.
We can provide a locum pharmacist, Ade Bakare, for Cornerstone on Tuesdays in November including 3 November, day rate 410.
I booked Ade Bakare from LocumLink for Tuesday 3 November to cover the Greendale Care Home flu jab morning at 410 for the day.
Tuesday 3 November works for Greendale; we will have the residents ready in the lounge from 10:00.
Invoice MW-4411: 200 units seasonal flu vaccine at 6.40, total 1280, delivered Friday 10 July to Cornerstone Community Pharmacy.
Fridge capacity note: our vaccine fridge comfortably holds 250 units of flu stock plus the regular lines, so the weekly 200-unit drops leave us good headroom.
Reminder that Cornerstone's standing weekly flu order is 200 units every Friday; just reply by Wednesday 17:00 if any week needs a different quantity.
Autumn flu campaign starts Monday 14 September; community pharmacies should expect walk-in demand roughly double the September baseline from mid-October.

Given the campaign starts 14 September and demand doubles from mid-October, I am keeping the weekly Medwell flu order at 200 units through October and will review quantities in November after we see actual walk-in numbers.
Noted, weekly flu drops for Cornerstone stay at 200 units each Friday through October.
Quote for 5000 flu campaign leaflets, A5 double-sided: 96 including delivery to Cornerstone Community Pharmacy.
I ordered 5000 flu campaign leaflets from Paper & Post at 96; it is under the 800 sign-off threshold so no approval needed from Priya.

Team huddle minutes: autumn flu plan confirmed - 200 units weekly from Medwell on Fridays, Priya receives and logs, Greendale visit Tuesday 3 November with locum Ade Bakare, leaflets arriving mid-September.
Delivery diary confirms Cornerstone's recurring Friday 09:00-11:00 window is held for you every week through November.
Booking confirmation invoice LL-882: Ade Bakare, pharmacist, Tuesday 3 November at Cornerstone Community Pharmacy, 410.
Resident count for the flu morning is now 34 confirmed plus 2 maybes; we will finalise the list the week before.
Promotional note for November: we can offer a bulk flu vaccine bundle of 240 units per weekly drop at 6.10 a unit for pharmacies wanting extra stock over the winter peak.
Saw Medwell's winter bundle offer of 240 units a week; noted it for the November review, no change to the current 200-unit plan.

Campaign update: the board's flu publicity van will visit the precinct outside Cornerstone Community Pharmacy on Wednesday 18 November, 10:00 to 14:00, handing out leaflets and directing walk-ins to participating pharmacies.
Good news about the publicity van on 18 November; no impact on the Friday deliveries, I will keep receiving them as usual.
Routine confirmation: your standing weekly flu order of 200 units each Friday continues; next drops 16, 23 and 30 October and 6 November.
Invoice MW-4558: 200 units seasonal flu vaccine at 6.40, total 1280, delivered Friday 16 October to Cornerstone Community Pharmacy.
Sue called to confirm the Greendale flu morning on Tuesday 3 November is all set for 10:00 with 34 residents on the final list.
Fridge book: 200-unit drop received and logged 09:35 today; stock level after today's clinics is 96 units.
Your account quote: emollient cream 500g tubs at 4.20 each, minimum order 10 tubs, delivery to Cornerstone in two working days.
I ordered 24 tubs of emollient cream from HealthKit Direct at 4.20 a tub, total 100.80, to replenish the shelf and cover Greendale's regular request; well under the 800 sign-off threshold.
Final confirmation that Ade Bakare attends Cornerstone on Tuesday 3 November, 09:00 start, before travelling to Greendale Care Home for the 10:00 flu morning.
